newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor up but overseas buying low on budget.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor up but overseas buying low on budget.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Friday rose to 1,199/1,200 rupees per quintal from 1,188/1,189 rupees on the back of fresh speculative buying, dealers said.
"Overseas buying remained low but bull operators turned active ahead of today's union budget on expectation that the finance minister may announce some export incentives," a dealer said.
The Bombay Oil Exchange is holding a special post-budget session for trading in oil and oilseeds from 1730 to 1900 (1200 GMT to 1330 GMT), one dealer said.

Groundnut oil was up by a rupee at 343/344 rupees per 10 kg amid limited activity. Sentiment was however firm on expectation that the finance minister may hike import duty on edible oil in the budget.
"Presently import duty on edible oil is 20 percent which may be raised to 30 percent," one miller said.
Imported palm oil was quiet at 281/282 rupees per 10 kg amid limited activity. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil moved up by 3/4 rupees at 518/519 rupees per 15 kg.
